What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `botan`: Botan 3.14.1: doc/api_ref/message_auth_codes.rst states no constant-time property of this MAC, and its source (src/lib/mac/) none.
* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man3/EVP_MAC.pod, doc/man7/EVP_MAC-HMAC.pod, EVP_MAC-KMAC.pod, EVP_MAC-BLAKE2.pod, EVP_MAC-Siphash.pod and providers/implementations/macs/ state no constant-time property.
* `xkcp`: XKCP at d20c8fc: README.markdown, lib/low/KeccakP-1600 and lib/high/Keccak (KeccakSponge, FIPS202/KeccakHash, SP800-185) state no constant-time property.

The default of `macs::kmac_128` and `macs::kmac_256`: `xkcp` on every target, whatever the program links; `botan`, `openssl` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
